name: Spark Cash Plus

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: Annual fee refunded every year you spend at least $150,000.

apr.notes: Purchase APR not stated on product page. Card is a charge card designed to be paid in full; you have the option to carry over a portion of your balance with interest if needed.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees. Pay zero foreign transaction fees on purchases made outside of the United States.

base_rate.description: Earn unlimited 2% cash back for your business on every purchase, everywhere, no limits or category restrictions.

categories.label: Hotels, vacation rentals and rental cars booked through Capital One Business Travel

rewards.redemption_notes: Get cash back rewards for any amount at any time with no expiration date for the life of the account. Redeem through statement credit or check.

signup_bonus.description: Earn a $2,000 cash bonus when you spend $30,000 in the first 3 months. Earn an additional $2,000 bonus for every $500,000 spent in the first year. Plus a one-time $500 Capital One Business Travel credit when you spend $30,000 in the first 3 months.

benefits.title: Annual fee refund
benefits.description: Get your $150 annual fee refunded every year you spend at least $150,000.

benefits.title: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.description: Pay zero foreign transaction fees on purchases made outside of the United States.

benefits.title: $0 fraud liability
benefits.description: If your card is lost or stolen, you can get an emergency replacement and a cash advance.

benefits.title: Free employee cards
benefits.description: Track employee spending while earning all the rewards from their purchases.

benefits.title: Virtual card numbers
benefits.description: Make safer payments online without exposing your actual card number with merchants.

benefits.title: Extended warranty
benefits.description: Get free additional warranty and protection on eligible items that you purchase with your card.

benefits.title: Roadside assistance
benefits.description: Our business cards offer services to help you during auto-related emergencies, such as jump-starting, tire changing and towing.

benefits.title: Year-end summaries
benefits.description: Get an itemized report of your spending to simplify budgeting and tax time.

benefits.title: Capital One Business Travel
benefits.description: Save time and money with complimentary access to an all-in-one business travel management solution.

benefits.title: Accounts Payable and Expense Management
benefits.description: Access to Accounts Payable and Expense Management solutions integrated directly within your Capital One Business account.

notes: Verified against official Capital One product page on 2026-07-25. Business charge card (pay-in-full, no preset spend limit). Network corrected to Mastercard (World Elite Business Mastercard); the page footnote lists a generic 'Visa or Mastercard' benefits guide, but Spark Cash Plus is issued on Mastercard. Added the 5% cash back on hotels, vacation rentals and rental cars booked through Capital One Business Travel category. Purchase APR not stated — preserved as null. Rewards currency is cash back.
